title: Unbounded derived Zariski-etale quasi-coherent comparison
statement: Use schemes [def-pc-scheme], algebraic spaces and their small etale structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and the unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ for objects with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Derived direct image is computed by K-injective resolutions, and derived tensor pullback by K-flat resolutions. For every scheme $Z$, the ringed-site map $\epsilon_Z:Z_{\mathrm{et}}\to Z_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ gives an exact pullback and an equivalence $\epsilon_Z^*:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{Z,\mathrm{Zar}})\xrightarrow{\sim}D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{Z,\mathrm{et}})$ with quasi-inverse $R\epsilon_{Z,*}$. It sends $\mathcal O_Z$ to $\mathcal O_{Z,\mathrm{et}}$. For a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme morphism $v:Z\to W$, the canonical comparison identifies $\epsilon_W^*Rv_{\mathrm{Zar},*}$ with $Rv_{\mathrm{et},*}\epsilon_Z^*$, naturally on unbounded quasi-coherent complexes. In particular these equivalences identify derived global sections on both sites.

source.place: Tag 071Q, lemma-derived-quasi-coherent-small-etale-site; Tag 08GH, remark-match-total-direct-images (pushforward diagram and its proof).

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-derived-etale-zariski-equivalence] with $T=Z$. It applies to every scheme, with no quasi-compactness or boundedness assumption. Its exact module pullback is precisely $\epsilon_Z^*$, and its equivalence is between the full subcategories defined by quasi-coherent cohomology, with $R\epsilon_{Z,*}$ as quasi-inverse and the canonical adjunction unit and counit as comparisons. The same statement identifies the structure modules; explicitly $\epsilon_Z^*\mathcal O_Z=\mathcal O_{Z,\mathrm{et}}\otimes_{\epsilon_Z^{-1}\mathcal O_Z}\epsilon_Z^{-1}\mathcal O_Z\simeq\mathcal O_{Z,\mathrm{et}}$ by multiplication, whose inverse is $b\mapsto b\otimes1$.

source.place: Tag 071Q, lemma-derived-quasi-coherent-small-etale-site; Tag 08GH, remark-match-total-direct-images (pushforward diagram and its proof).

proof.text: For $v:Z\to W$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated, specialize the direct-image clause of [lem-sfb-derived-etale-zariski-equivalence] to $h=v$. It gives the natural isomorphism $\epsilon_W^*Rv_{\mathrm{Zar},*}\simeq Rv_{\mathrm{et},*}\epsilon_Z^*$ on the unbounded quasi-coherent derived categories. These are the canonical comparisons from the commuting ringed-site square, as specified there. Only this clause needs the quasi-compact and quasi-separated hypothesis; no separatedness, finite type, or boundedness assumption is introduced.

For global sections, take any $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{Z,\mathrm{et}})$ and choose $E\to I$ K-injective by [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist], taking both sites small in the module universe as in [lem-sfb-derived-etale-zariski-equivalence]. Restriction $\epsilon_{Z,*}I$ is K-injective: for any acyclic Zariski complex $A$, adjunction identifies maps $A\to\epsilon_{Z,*}I$, including their homotopies, with maps $\epsilon_Z^*A\to I$; exactness of $\epsilon_Z^*$ makes its source acyclic, so every such map is null-homotopic by [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Thus the K-injective definition of derived global sections [def-pur-ringed-site-zeroth-hypercohomology] gives the identity of representative complexes $R\Gamma(Z_{\mathrm{Zar}},R\epsilon_{Z,*}E)=\Gamma(Z_{\mathrm{Zar}},\epsilon_{Z,*}I)=\Gamma(Z_{\mathrm{et}},I)=R\Gamma(Z_{\mathrm{et}},E)$, since restriction has the same value on the final object $Z$. The identity commutes with all maps of these representatives. Substituting $E=\epsilon_Z^*F$ and using the canonical unit $F\simeq R\epsilon_{Z,*}\epsilon_Z^*F$ from step 1 gives the claimed natural comparison for every unbounded $F$.
